author: ryan
text: Priya — Halvorsen needs a GA date in writing by next week or they go with a competitor. Can I tell them Dec 1?

author: priya
text: No. I can't commit to a GA date until enterprise SSO verification on Nov 10. I'll give you a date after that. Please don't put Dec 1 in writing.

author: ryan
text: Ok... I may have already mentioned Dec 1 in an email. I'll walk it back to 'December, pending SSO verification'.
